package agentfs

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "testing"
)

type auditFailDestinationCache struct { LocalCache }
func (c auditFailDestinationCache) Put(ctx context.Context, copyID, path string, content []byte) error {
    if path == "b.txt" { return errors.New("simulated disk full") }
    return c.LocalCache.Put(ctx, copyID, path, content)
}

func TestAuditMovePreservesUnpublishedContentOnCacheFailure(t *testing.T) {
    ctx := context.Background()
    stack := newCoreStack(t, testCaps(), nil)
    actor := testActor("editor")
    seedRemoteFiles(t, stack, ctx, map[string]string{"a.txt": "original"})
    journal, cache := newMemJournal(), newMemCache()
    manager := newManager(t, stack, journal, cache, 2)
    wc, err := manager.Checkout(ctx, actor, "acme", "main", "/tmp/audit-wc", "audit-copy")
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if _, err := manager.Write(ctx, actor, wc, "a.txt", nil, []byte("unpublished edit")); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    manager.cache = auditFailDestinationCache{LocalCache: cache}
    _, moveErr := manager.Move(ctx, actor, wc, "a.txt", "b.txt", nil, nil)
    if moveErr == nil { t.Error("Move reported success after destination cache write failed") }
    if data, err := cache.Get(ctx, wc.ID, "a.txt"); err != nil || string(data) != "unpublished edit" {
        t.Errorf("source unpublished content lost: data=%q err=%v", data, err)
    }
    if _, err := cache.Get(ctx, wc.ID, "b.txt"); err != nil {
        t.Logf("destination also absent: %v", err)
    }
}
